qualification.details: Project Associate-I: B.E/B.Tech. in Chemical Engineering from a recognized University. Experience: Field work, data collection, sample analysis, data compilation and assistance in report preparation.

salary_details.pay_scale: Rs. 31,000/- + HRA for those candidates who have qualified CSIR-UGC / ICAR / ICMR / NPTEL fellowship / Assistant professorship or GATE, Rs. 25,000/- + HRA for others who do not fall under (a) above.

how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the CSIR NEERI Project Associate-I Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 03-09-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of CSIR NEERI to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the CSIR NEERI Project Associate-I Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 03-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of CSIR NEERI to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the CSIR NEERI Project Associate-I recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form is 03 September 2026. It is advisable to apply well in advance to avoid any last-minute technical issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Associate-I position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.E/B.Tech degree in Chemical Engineering from a recognized University to be eligible for the Project Associate-I position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Associate-I role?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Associate-I position is 35 years. Age relaxation details, if any, will be mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate-I position?
faq.answer: The salary is Rs. 31,000/- + HRA for candidates with CSIR-UGC/ICAR/ICMR/NPTEL fellowship/Assistant professorship or GATE qualification, and Rs. 25,000/- + HRA for others.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Project Associate-I post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Associate-I position in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for CSIR NEERI Project Associate-I recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an Online Interview and Review committee assessment.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for the CSIR NEERI Project Associate-I posts?
faq.answer: The application process is strictly online. Candidates need to apply through the official website of CSIR NEERI.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for project-based positions on a purely temporary basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the CSIR NEERI located?
faq.answer: CSIR NEERI is located in Nagpur, Maharashtra, with a pincode of 440020.
